# API Contracts: School Management System

**Version**: v1  
**Base Path**: `/api/v1`  
**Auth**: All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <supabase_jwt>` except `GET /health`.  
**Response envelope**: All responses include `request_id` (UUID string).  
**Format**: OpenAPI 3.1 summary — full schema in `openapi.yaml` (generated by FastAPI).

---

## Standard Response Envelope

```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": { ... },          // present on success
  "error": {                // present on error
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "details": { ... }      // optional, validation errors etc.
  }
}
```

**HTTP status codes used**:
- `200 OK` — read success
- `201 Created` — resource created
- `204 No Content` — delete / no body
- `400 Bad Request` — validation error
- `401 Unauthorized` — missing or invalid JWT
- `403 Forbidden` — valid JWT, insufficient role/scope
- `404 Not Found` — resource not found in tenant scope
- `409 Conflict` — business rule violation (overbooking, immutable record, etc.)
- `422 Unprocessable Entity` — Pydantic validation failure

## Health

### `GET /health`

Public. Returns server health. Does **not** follow standard response envelope.

**Response 200**:
```json
{ "status": "ok", "version": "0.1.0" }
```

## Auth / Profile

### `GET /api/v1/me`

Returns the authenticated user's profile and all their role memberships. On first login (user record does not exist), this endpoint automatically creates the `User` record from the Supabase JWT claims (email, name, avatar).

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "first_name": "Jane",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "avatar_url": "https://...",
    "roles": [
      { "school_id": "uuid", "school_name": "Sky High School", "role": "school_admin" },
      { "school_id": null, "school_name": null, "role": "super_admin" }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schools

### `GET /api/v1/schools`

**Roles**: super_admin  
Returns all schools.

### `POST /api/v1/schools`

**Roles**: super_admin

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "name": "Sky High Paragliding School",
  "slug": "sky-high",
  "company_id": "ABN1234567890",
  "email": "admin@skyhigh.com",
  "phone_number": "+1-619-555-0123",
  "discipline": "paragliding_hangliding",
  "address_street": "123 Launch Road",
  "address_city": "San Diego",
  "address_region": "CA",
  "address_country": "US",
  "address_postal_code": "92109",
  "default_currency": "USD"
}
```

**Response 201**: school object.

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin (own school), instructor (own school), student (own school)

### `PATCH /api/v1/schools/{school_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin (own school)

## School Members (UserRole)

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/members`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin  
Returns all members with roles.

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/members`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin  
Assigns a role to an existing user within the school.

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "user_id": "uuid",
  "role": "instructor"
}
```

**Response 201**: user_role object.  
**Response 409**: if removing would leave school with zero admins (on role change).

### `DELETE /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/members/{user_id}/roles/{role}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin  
**Response 409**: if deleting the last school_admin.

## Syllabuses

### `GET /api/v1/syllabuses`

**Roles**: all authenticated  
Returns syllabuses based on the context of the request:
- **When creating a course** (no context or `?context=course_creation`): Returns active **final** syllabuses visible to the user (system-wide + school-specific for their school).
- **When editing drafts** (`?context=editing`): Returns only the **latest active draft** per syllabus (their own school drafts) + active **final** syllabuses they can create drafts from.

**Query params**: `context` (optional: `course_creation`, `editing`), `discipline`, `page`, `page_size`

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "school_id": null,
      "title": "P2 Ground School",
      "status": "final",
      "version": 1,
      "description": "...",
      "discipline": "paragliding_hangliding",
      "created_at": "2026-02-24T...",
      "lessons": [ ... ]
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "total": 5, "page": 1, "page_size": 20 }
}
```

### `POST /api/v1/syllabuses`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

Creates a new **Draft** syllabus. Super-admins create system-wide drafts (`school_id=null`); school-admins create school-specific drafts.

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "title": "P2 Ground School",
  "description": "...",
  "discipline": "paragliding_hangliding",
  "lessons": [
    {
      "title": "Equipment Familiarization",
      "description": "...",
      "duration_hours": 2.0,
      "sequence_order": 1,
      "learning_objectives": ["Identify glider components"]
    }
  ]
}
```

**Response 201**: draft syllabus with `status = 'draft'`, `version = null`.

### `GET /api/v1/syllabuses/{syllabus_id}`

**Roles**: all authenticated (if visible to school), super_admin (if system-wide)

Returns both draft and final syllabuses the user can access.

### `PUT /api/v1/syllabuses/{syllabus_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin (system-wide), school_admin (own school syllabuses)

Updates a **Draft** syllabus. Cannot modify final syllabuses directly.

**Request body**: any updatable fields (title, description, lessons array, etc.)

**Response 200**: updated draft syllabus.  
**Response 409**: if attempting to edit a final syllabus (must finalize draft instead).

### `POST /api/v1/syllabuses/{syllabus_id}/finalize`

**Roles**: super_admin (system-wide), school_admin (own school)

Finalizes a **Draft** syllabus, making it immutable and assigning a version number. Once finalized, editing it creates a new draft as a child.

**Request body**: `{}` (no params needed)

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "final",
    "version": 1,
    "title": "P2 Ground School",
    ...
  }
}
```

**Response 409**: if syllabus is already final.

### `POST /api/v1/syllabuses/{syllabus_id}/copy`

**Roles**: school_admin (for copying system-wide final syllabuses into their school)

Creates a new **Draft** as a copy of a system-wide final syllabus for the school.

**Request body**: `{}`

**Response 201**: new school-specific draft with `parent_syllabus_id = {original_id}`.

### `DELETE /api/v1/syllabuses/{syllabus_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin (own school)  
Soft-delete (`is_active = false`). Works on both draft and final syllabuses.

## Courses

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (own courses), student (enrolled courses)

**Query params**: `status`, `page`, `page_size`

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/available`

**Roles**: student

Returns courses available for enrollment within the student’s school (not yet enrolled).

**Query params**: `status`, `page`, `page_size`

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

Creates a course from a **final** syllabus. The `syllabus_id` must reference a final (immutable) syllabus. The syllabus version is determined by the referenced syllabus row's `version` field. Courses must follow the syllabus exactly; lesson content cannot be customized. A course is only considered `planned` once the **first lesson** has a scheduled `start_time` and `location` set by an assigned instructor.

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "syllabus_id": "uuid",           // must be a final syllabus (status='final')
  "title": "Spring P2 Course 2026",
  "description": "...",
  "max_students": 15
}
```

**Response 201**: course with embedded `course_lessons`, bound immutably to the final syllabus.  
**Response 409**: if `syllabus_id` references a draft (must be final) or if the syllabus is inactive.

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned), student (enrolled)

### `PATCH /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin  
Partial update: `title`, `description`, `max_students`. `status` is system-derived; only `cancelled` may be set explicitly and only if course has not started (`status = planned`). `planned` → `running` occurs automatically when the first lesson starts (unless admin override is required).

### `DELETE /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin  
Sets `status = cancelled` and triggers notifications to enrolled students and assigned instructors.

## Course Lessons

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned), student (enrolled)

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned), student (enrolled)

### `PATCH /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}`

**Roles**: instructor (assigned)  
Partial update: `start_time`, `location` only. Lesson content (`title`, `description`, `duration_hours`, `sequence_order`) is immutable and must match the syllabus.  
Changing `start_time` or `location` re-triggers overbooking check for all assigned instructors. Lesson start requires assigned instructor and no conflicts; lesson auto-starts at `start_time` if all enrolled students are paid, otherwise a school admin must override.

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}/complete`

**Roles**: instructor (assigned to this lesson)  
Marks lesson as `completed`.

**Business rules enforced**:
- All enrolled students must have a `StudentLessonEvaluation` with non-null `result`.
- Sets `is_immutable = true` on all evaluations for this lesson.
- Triggers email notifications to students with feedback notes.

**Response 200**: updated lesson.  
**Response 409**: missing evaluations — returns list of student IDs without evaluation.

---

## Instructor Assignments

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/instructors`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (own), student (enrolled — sees names only)

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/instructors`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "instructor_id": "uuid",
  "course_lesson_id": "uuid"
}
```

`course_lesson_id` is optional; if omitted, instructor is assigned to all lessons in course.

**Response 201**: assignment object.  
**Response 409**: overbooking conflict — returns conflicting lesson details.

### `DELETE /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/instructors/{assignment_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

### `GET /api/v1/instructors/{instructor_id}/schedule`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (own)  
Returns assigned lessons ordered by `start_time`. For school_admin and instructor roles, results are scoped to the requester’s school. Super-admins may use `school_id` to filter across schools.

**Query params**: `school_id` (optional filter), `from_date`, `to_date`

---

## Enrollments

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned — sees names + status only)

**Query params**: `status`, `page`, `page_size`

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments`

**Roles**: student (self-register), school_admin (manual enroll)

**Request body (student self-register)**:
```json
{ "student_id": "uuid (self)" }
```

**Request body (admin manual enroll)**:
```json
{ "student_id": "uuid", "bypass_approval": true }
```

**Response 201**: enrollment with `status = pending_approval` (student) or `enrolled` (admin bypass).

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{enrollment_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, student (own)

### `PATCH /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{enrollment_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

Updates enrollment fields controlled by the school admin (e.g., marking payment received).

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "payment_status": "paid" // allowed: "paid", "not_paid"
}
```

**Response 200**: updated enrollment.

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{enrollment_id}/approve`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

**Business rule**: School admin marks student as paid via `PATCH` to set `payment_status = 'paid'`. After payment is recorded, admin calls this endpoint. Approval directly transitions status to `enrolled` (if capacity) or `waitlist` (if full); there is no intermediate `approved` state.

**Response 200**: enrollment with updated status (`enrolled` or `waitlist` if at capacity).

### `POST /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{enrollment_id}/reject`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

**Request body**:
```json
{ "reason": "Course not suitable for current skill level." }
```

**Response 200**: enrollment with `status = rejected`.

### `DELETE /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/enrollments/{enrollment_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin (any student), student (own, only if `status = 'pending_approval'` or `'waitlist'`)

**Business rule**: Students can exit the waitlist themselves. Once enrolled (after payment and admin approval), only school admins can unenroll students. Admins can choose to set `status = waiting` (student wants the next course, with student agreement) or `status = unenrolled` (not interested). Refunds are handled externally; the system records only `paid`/`not_paid`. Triggers FIFO waitlist promotion if applicable.

---

## Student Lesson Evaluations

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}/evaluations`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned)  
Returns all evaluations for the lesson.

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}/evaluations/{student_id}`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned), student (own — `result` and `feedback_notes` only after lesson completion; `admin_notes` hidden)

### `PUT /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/lessons/{lesson_id}/evaluations/{student_id}`

**Roles**: instructor (assigned)  
Create or update evaluation. Upsert semantics. Email notifications to students are sent **only after the lesson is marked complete** (when `course_lesson.status = 'completed'`), not when evaluation notes are initially saved.

**Request body**:
```json
{
  "result": "pass",
  "feedback_notes": "Excellent ground handling. Ready for next stage.",
  "admin_notes": "Student nervous but improving. Monitor in next session."
}
```

**Response 200**: evaluation object.  
**Response 409**: if `is_immutable = true` (lesson already completed).

---

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/courses/{course_id}/progress`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin, instructor (assigned), student (enrolled)

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": {
    "course_id": "uuid",
    "total_lessons": 10,
    "completed_lessons": 3,
    "progress_percent": 30,
    "course_status": "in_progress",
    "lessons": [
      { "id": "uuid", "title": "...", "status": "completed", "sequence_order": 1 },
      ...
    ]
  }
}
```

## Instructor Availability Check

### `GET /api/v1/schools/{school_id}/instructors/availability`

**Roles**: super_admin, school_admin

**Query params**:
- `instructor_id` (required)
- `start_time` (ISO 8601, required)
- `duration_hours` (number, required)
- `location` (string, required)
- `exclude_lesson_id` (UUID, optional — for rescheduling)

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "data": {
    "available": false,
    "conflicts": [
      {
        "course_lesson_id": "uuid",
        "course_title": "Spring P2",
        "lesson_title": "First Flight",
        "start_time": "2026-03-01T09:00:00Z",
        "end_time": "2026-03-01T11:00:00Z",
        "location": "Torrey Pines launch site"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
